name: Progress Circle
description: A radial progress indicator with determinate and indeterminate modes.

anatomy.description: Muted full circle that anchors the fill.
Primary arc whose dash offset encodes the value; spins as a dashed arc when indeterminate.
Centered percentage readout shown in determinate mode; hidden from assistive technology because the progressbar value carries it.

dos: Set an explicit size per context instead of scaling the circle.
Always pass a label so the progressbar has an accessible name.
donts: Don't use it for precise values in dense tables; use Progress or plain text.
Don't shrink it below the size where the percentage label stays legible.

examples.title: Radial progress
examples.description: role="progressbar" carries the value; omit value for a spinning indeterminate arc.

examples.title: Indeterminate work
examples.description: Omit value while progress cannot be measured.

guidance.useWhen: Progress needs a compact radial treatment.
guidance.avoidWhen: A precise value matters in a table; use Progress.
guidance.behavior: Determinate mode exposes aria-valuenow; omit value for indeterminate.
guidance.responsive: Set an explicit size per context instead of scaling.

notes: Rendered as role="progressbar" with an aria-label; determinate mode adds aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, and aria-valuenow.
The centered percentage is aria-hidden because the progressbar value already carries it.
The fill transition is disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

props.description: Completion percentage between 0 and 100. Omit for an indeterminate spinner.
props.name: value

props.description: Diameter of the circle in pixels.
props.name: size

props.description: Width of the track and fill strokes in pixels.
props.name: strokeWidth
